outputs.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution reconstruction images (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation) — a micrograph-type panel, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows super-resolution reconstruction images analogous to A — a micrograph-type panel, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell with mean ± SEM bars; individual data points (gray dots per cell) are already overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes with mean ± SEM bars; individual data points (gray dots per cluster) are already overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of percentage of molecules in clusters per cell with mean ± SEM bars; individual data points (gray dots per cell) are already overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows super-resolution localization and trajectory reconstruction images — a micrograph-type panel, not a plot of averaged data.
Histogram of diffusion coefficients shows the full distribution of raw measurements itself; it is not an averaged summary statistic requiring overlaid individual points.
Mean square displacement is shown as a line plot of individual trajectories over time; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph, image-based representations rather than a plot of averaged/aggregated data.
